# American Grit

> > American Grit delivers military entertainment, veteran news, and extreme challenge content celebrating service members and supporting military causes.

American Grit is a digital media platform featuring veteran-focused entertainment, military news coverage, extreme fitness challenges, and lifestyle content. The site produces original video series like 'Alex Will Do It' alongside veteran career guidance, military history, and charity-driven challenges supporting fallen service members and veteran organizations.

## Key Topics

- Military Entertainment
- Veteran News
- Alex Will Do It
- Extreme Challenges
- Charity Challenges
- Military Technology
- Self-Defense
- Fallen Service Members
- Las Vegas Knights
- Grunt Style
- The Folded Flag Foundation
- Active Duty
- Veterans Benefits
- Marksmanship
- Military History

## Live & Streaming

- [Live](https://www.americangrit.com/live): Live shows and streaming content featuring veteran stories and entertainment.

## Veterans Benefits & Career

- [VA Mailing Payments: Free Banking for Vets](https://www.americangrit.com/post/250k-vets-receiving-mailed-payments-va-offering-free-banking-program): VA Veterans Benefits Banking Program news for 250k receiving veterans.
- [5 Mistakes Veterans Make With Their Resumes](https://www.americangrit.com/post/5-mistakes-veterans-make-with-their-resumes): Career advice guide helping veterans optimize job search resumes.
